sloka: नारदस्तुम्बुरुर्गोप: प्रवरा: सूर्य्यवर्चस: ।एते गन्धर्वराजानो भरतस्याग्रतो जगु: ॥ २.९१.४५॥
transliteration: nāradastumbururgopa: pravarā: sūryyavarcasa: ।ete gandharvarājāno bharatasyāgrato jagu: ॥ 2.91.45॥

translations.english: Troops of twenty thousand apsaras by whom any man when taken hold of in their arms could be intoxicated with intense passion, came from Nandana gardens.
